# Launch a codex worker

codex has no paneless background start of its own. Pick the host by who watches.

An unattended teammate runs on fno's codex thread lane. Spawn hosts it on the codex app-server and keeps no pane:

```bash
fno agents spawn -H codex -m gpt-6-sol --effort high -Y --name <name> --node <node> '$fno:target <node>'
```

To watch the worker, run codex's own line in a keeper pane. fno places the pane. Every word after `--` reaches codex verbatim:

```bash
fno mux pane run --cwd <repo-root> -- codex -m gpt-6-sol -a never -s workspace-write -c model_reasoning_effort=high '$fno:target <node>'
```

## The payload

The payload starts with `$fno:`, never `/`. Single-quote it. Inside double quotes the shell expands `$fno` to nothing, and the worker reads the rest as prose. Spawn refuses both bad shapes and names the fix.

## What fno does around the line

- **Gate.** The PreToolUse Bash hook reads either line and asks the spawn gate. A refusal denies the Bash call and names the remedy.
- **Record.** The hook writes a launch record with your session as the parent. For a pane run it parses the codex argv after `--`.
- **Adopt.** codex's SessionStart hook (`hooks/codex-hooks.json`) reports the session, and fno mints its row.

On spawn, `-Y` maps to codex `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`. On the native line, write codex's own flag. Models: `gpt-6-astra`, `gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-6-luna`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, `gpt-5.6-luna`, `gpt-5.5`.

## Get the result back

- `fno agents list` and `fno agents peek <name>` read the row and its latest turn.
- `fno agents mail send <name> "<text>"` reaches it. A busy worker leaves mail in the composer, so peek after every send.
- `codex resume <id> --remote unix://` rejoins a session by hand.

## Known refusals

- The footnote plugin is `missing` or `wrong-channel` in the codex home. Spawn refuses a command-shaped seed. Run `fno config plugin install codex`, then launch again.
- `--permission-mode` on a thread or headless spawn. Use `-Y`, or run the native line in a pane.
- `--agent` is rejected. codex reaches sub-agents through its own project agents.

Back to [the harness choice table](../SKILL.md#launch-a-worker).

#### Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `agents` | Browse all agent sessions on the shared local app-server daemon |

| `logout` | Remove stored authentication credentials |
| `mcp` | Manage external MCP servers for Codex |

| `app` | Launch the Desktop app (opens the app installer if missing) |
| `completion` | Generate shell completion scripts |
| `update` | Update Codex to the latest version |
| `doctor` | Diagnose local Codex installation, config, auth, and runtime health |
| `sandbox` | Run commands within a Codex-provided sandbox |
| `debug` | Debugging tools |
| `apply` | Apply the latest diff produced by Codex agent as a `git apply` to your local working tree [aliases: a] |
| `resume` | Resume a previous interactive session (picker by default; use --last to continue the most recent) |
| `queue` | Queue a message for an existing session |
| `archive` | Archive a saved session by id or session name |
| `delete` | Permanently delete a saved session by id or session name |
| `migrate-rollouts` | Inspect or migrate legacy local sessions to paginated thread history |
| `unarchive` | Unarchive a saved session by id or session name |
| `fork` | Fork a previous interactive session (picker by default; use --last to fork the most recent) |
| `cloud` | [EXPERIMENTAL] Browse tasks from Codex Cloud and apply changes locally |
| `exec-server` | [EXPERIMENTAL] Run the standalone exec-server service |
| `features` | Inspect feature flags |

#### Options

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-c, --config <key=value>` | Override a configuration value that would otherwise be loaded from `~/.codex/config.toml`. Use a dotted path (`foo.bar.baz`) to override nested values. The `value` portion is parsed as TOML. If it fails to parse as TOML, the raw string is used as a literal. Examples: - `-c model="o3"` - `-c 'sandbox_permissions=["disk-full-read-access"]'` - `-c shell_environment_policy.inherit=all` |
| `--enable <FEATURE>` | Enable a feature (repeatable). Equivalent to `-c features.<name>=true` |
| `--disable <FEATURE>` | Disable a feature (repeatable). Equivalent to `-c features.<name>=false` |
| `--remote <ADDR>` | Connect the TUI to a remote app server endpoint. Accepted forms: `ws://host:port`, `wss://host:port`, `unix://`, or `unix://PATH`. |
| `--remote-auth-token-env <ENV_VAR>` | Name of the environment variable containing the bearer token to send to a remote app server websocket |
| `--strict-config` | Error out when config.toml contains fields that are not recognized by this version of Codex |
| `-i, --image <FILE>...` | Optional image(s) to attach to the initial prompt |
| `-m, --model <MODEL>` | Model the agent should use |
| `--oss` | Use open-source provider |
| `--local-provider <OSS_PROVIDER>` | Specify which local provider to use (lmstudio or ollama). If not specified with --oss, will use config default or show selection |
| `-p, --profile <CONFIG_PROFILE_V2>` | Layer $CODEX_HOME/<name>.config.toml on top of the base user config |
| `-s, --sandbox <SANDBOX_MODE>` | Select the sandbox policy to use when executing model-generated shell commands [possible values: read-only, workspace-write, danger-full-access] |
| `--approve-for-me` | Route approval requests through automatic review using the workspace-write sandbox |
| `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` | Skip all confirmation prompts and execute commands without sandboxing. EXTREMELY DANGEROUS. Intended solely for running in environments that are externally sandboxed |
| `--dangerously-bypass-hook-trust` | Run enabled hooks without requiring persisted hook trust for this invocation. DANGEROUS. Intended only for automation that already vets hook sources |
| `-C, --cd <DIR>` | Tell the agent to use the specified directory as its working root |
| `--worktree` | Run the session in a new managed Git worktree |
| `--add-dir <DIR>` | Additional directories that should be writable alongside the primary workspace |
| `-a, --ask-for-approval <APPROVAL_POLICY>` | Configure when the model requires human approval before executing a command Possible values: - on-request: The model decides when to ask the user for approval - never: Never ask for user approval Execution failures are immediately returned to the model |
| `--search` | Enable live web search. When enabled, the native Responses `web_search` tool is available to the model (no per‑call approval) |
| `--no-alt-screen` | Disable alternate screen mode Runs the TUI in inline mode, preserving terminal scrollback history. |
| `--no-daemon` | Run without the shared background server, even if it is already running |
| `-h, --help` | Print help (see a summary with '-h') |
| `-V, --version` | Print version |
